name: JennShootingOperations

invocationCommands.description:
只读查询当前权威订单、资源、排期和进度，不执行排期变更。参数：command（必填）固定为 read_state；payload_json（可选）必须是 JSON 对象的字符串，省略时默认为 {}，按服务端已配置的资源白名单查询。可用 {"resourceScope":["<已获准的资源ID>"]} 缩小范围，不得猜测或扩展资源。不要传 date、role、token、approved 等额外字段。可选 VCP 署名 maid/valet 仅为不可信追踪信息（非空字符串，最多160字符，无控制字符；同时出现时须一致），不授予身份或写权限。最简调用：
<<<[TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
tool_name:「始」JennShootingOperations「末」,
command:「始」read_state「末」
<<<[END_TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
显式空参数：
<<<[TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
tool_name:「始」JennShootingOperations「末」,
command:「始」read_state「末」,
payload_json:「始」{}「末」
<<<[END_TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
invocationCommands.example:
<<<[TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
maid:「始」示例助手「末」,
tool_name:「始」JennShootingOperations「末」,
command:「始」read_state「末」,
payload_json:「始」{}「末」
<<<[END_TOOL_REQUEST]>>>

invocationCommands.description: Read-only same-day numeric shift preview; does not execute a change. Direct tool invocation uses command preview_shift and payload_json containing all six required fields: operationId (a new unique string), scheduleItemId, resourceId, minutes (integer), expectedScheduleRevision, expectedProjectionRevision. Obtain IDs and both revisions from the latest read_state result; do not guess them. Separately, to present the suggestion in chat, output one fenced vcp-tool-proposal JSON block: {"tool":"JennShootingOperations","payload":{"scheduleItemId":"<authoritative id>","minutes":1}}. This two-field chat proposal is NOT the direct preview_shift payload. The host re-reads impact and presents it; a later native confirmation is required. Never add approval/role/credential fields.
invocationCommands.example:
<<<[TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
tool_name:「始」JennShootingOperations「末」,
command:「始」preview_shift「末」,
payload_json:「始」{"operationId":"<new unique id>","scheduleItemId":"<latest read_state session id>","resourceId":"<latest read_state resource id>","minutes":1,"expectedScheduleRevision":2,"expectedProjectionRevision":5}「末」
<<<[END_TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
The revision numbers are illustrative; replace them with both revisions returned by the latest read_state.

invocationCommands.description: 只读核对原操作回执，不重新提交。参数：command（必填）固定为 read_receipt；payload_json（必填）为 JSON 对象字符串 {"operationId":"<原操作ID>"}，必须使用真实原ID，不得生成新ID重试。可选 maid/valet 的署名规则同 read_state，不参与授权。仅接受资源范围内的 reschedule 回执。 Full-adoption proposalDecision receipts additionally require explicit complete resource scope and the original decisionId. Unknown outcomes must only query the original operation ID; never automatically retry.
invocationCommands.example:
<<<[TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
tool_name:「始」JennShootingOperations「末」,
command:「始」read_receipt「末」,
payload_json:「始」{"operationId":"<原操作ID>"}「末」
<<<[END_TOOL_REQUEST]>>>

invocationCommands.description: Read-only deterministic proposal preview. payload_json requires operationId, planningWindowStart, planningWindowEnd and resourceScope from authoritative state. To request full adoption presentation, output one top-level fenced vcp-tool-proposal block with {"tool":"JennShootingOperations","payload":{"action":"adopt_proposal","planningWindowStart":"<RFC3339>","planningWindowEnd":"<RFC3339>"}}. The host supplies the configured resource, creates fresh operation IDs, checks the operator-approved synthetic request allowlist, and displays every proposed item. Only later native human confirmation can execute. Model/stdin adopt_proposal is forbidden; partial adoption is unsupported.
invocationCommands.example: command=generate_proposal; payload_json must be the exact existing generation command JSON.
